tests.prompt: The cart page becomes blank whenever I remove an item.
tests.expected: The assistant recognizes this as a bug report, does not call the bug-report tool because required information is missing, and asks one focused follow-up question to collect missing reproduction steps.
The assistant answers using the FAQ: estimated delivery times are shown at checkout and in the shipping confirmation email, and processing typically takes 1-2 business days before dispatch.

The assistant does not invent a student discount policy. It explains that the available support information does not confirm this and directs the customer to support using FAQ-supported contact methods.

tests.prompt: Can you help me write a Python program?
tests.expected: The assistant recognizes that this request is outside online-shop customer support, does not answer the programming question, and politely redirects the customer.
